title: Faster MLE with Strong Tag Consistency
summary: CE provides strong tag consistency, while faster known MLE schemes do not; it remains open whether faster MLE can retain that security.

formal_statement.body: For Message-Locked Encryption (MLE), CE achieves strong tag consistency (STC) security, whereas the faster HCE1, HCE2, and RCE schemes lose STC security; determine whether this performance-versus-STC-security tradeoff is fundamental, so that no faster MLE schemes can retain STC security, or whether faster MLE schemes retaining STC security exist.

scope.domain: Design of message-locked encryption schemes balancing performance and strong tag consistency.
parameters: CE: MLE construction achieving STC security
HCE1, HCE2, and RCE: faster MLE constructions that lose STC security
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the performance-versus-STC-security tradeoff is fundamental or faster STC-secure MLE schemes exist.

progress.summary: The source contrasts STC-secure CE with the faster HCE1, HCE2, and RCE schemes, which lose STC security. It explicitly leaves open whether this tradeoff is fundamental or can be overcome.
citation_labels: Mihir Bellare et al., Message-Locked Encryption and Secure Deduplication
